reviews.author: MinJoo Kim
reviews.text:
A golden opportunity to lose money and time!

A scary space that provides an hour of Celltrion massage and then closes for about an hour. You can feel how difficult it is for Celltrion.

If you participate in an event outside of an exhibition or performance hall where you receive samples after providing simple personal information (name, phone number, age, etc.), you will receive phone calls targeting mainly women in their 20s. If you come to this place with "30,000 won in cash" and your ID card, you will receive a call saying that you have won an event that will provide a massage worth 150,000 won. In fact, it is not an event, but a hard sell.

I visited because I was curious about what it was like, but I was very disappointed, so I am posting a long review so that you don't suffer the same damage as I did.
1. Unclean space. - Dirty skin diagnosis machine. A wrinkled, sour-smelling gown. The massage therapist's hands are unclear as to when they were washed.
2. Skin care and décolleté/facial massage by the therapist, whose expertise cannot be confirmed.
3. Offensive and blatant business hours. - A ridiculous request to issue a credit card and make purchases if you don't have money. There is even a comment that violates the Ministry of Food and Drug Safety regulation that cosmetics reach the dermal layer!
4. Result of losing 30,000 won in cash and 2 hours of precious life time.
Everything was fantastically bad! To the point where I’m thankful that I don’t have any skin problems. I hope everyone is careful. There is nothing free in this world.
